news.description: Seoul Samsung won its eighth consecutive opening victory, setting the record for the most consecutive opening wins in the KBL. Now, we will challenge for the first nine consecutive opening victories and first-round victories. Seoul Samsung won 76-68 away games with Daegu Korea Gas Corporation in the first round of the 2026-2027 KCC Professional Basketball League at Daegu Gymnasium on the 25th. As a result, Samsung has won all eight of its games since its opening.
